ext.description: Manage Claude Code terminal sessions as threads: open, switch, close; saved per project as Open / Done. Not affiliated with Anthropic.
view.welcome:
Open a project folder first.
[Open Folder](command:vscode.openFolder)
cfg.language: Language of the panel, messages and transcripts. Command titles follow the VS Code display language.
cfg.language.auto: Follow the VS Code display language
cfg.extraArgs: Extra arguments added to every thread (e.g. --permission-mode auto).
cfg.saveFolder: Folder inside the project where threads are saved.
cfg.terminalLocation.editor: Each thread opens as its own editor tab
cfg.terminalLocation.panel: Threads open in the bottom terminal panel
cfg.showUntracked: Also list older sessions started outside the extension under Done.
